```{r fertility-decide}
decide_fert
```


## Combine

```{r fertility-combine-importance}
vis_importance_2dim(
  decide_vec(mv_fert, colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate"),
  fanova_fert |> fanova_to_vec()
)
```

## Composite importance table

```{r fertility-importance-composite}
compose_importance_table(
  decide = decide_fert,
  fanova_main = calc_fanova_main_importance(mv_fert, colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate"),
  fanova_total = fanova_fert |> fanova_total_to_vec(),
  regression = regimp_fert,
  caption = "Importance estimates per decision, by method (Fertility).",
  label = "importance-fertility"
)
```

# Ablation Study

Fix each decision to one option, recompute the importance estimates on the
reduced multiverse, and compare the resulting importance vectors across
methods and across options of the fixed decision.

```{r fertility-ablation-run}
ablation_fert <- run_ablation_analysis(
  mv_fert,
  colname_metric = "fertility_low_estimate"
)
```

## Inter-method stability

The table below shows the baseline agreement between methods on the full
multiverse, plus the average agreement after fixing each decision and averaging
over that decision's options.

```{r fertility-ablation-inter-method-table}
ablation_fert$inter_method_stability_summary |>
  mutate(
    fixed_decision_label = if_else(
      fixed_decision == "full_multiverse",
      "full multiverse",
      fixed_decision_label
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method_x,
    method_y,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation
  )
```

```{r fertility-ablation-inter-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 3.2
#| fig-height: 3
# same row order in the inter- and intra-method heatmaps
decision_order_fert <- stability_decision_order(ablation_fert$intra_method_stability_summary)
p_inter_fert <- vis_inter_method_stability(
  ablation_fert$inter_method_stability_summary,
  include_negative = FALSE,
  decision_order = decision_order_fert,
  value_size = 1.6
) + theme_stability_compact(left_margin = 22)
p_inter_fert
```

```{r fertility-ablation-inter-method-matrix}
#| fig-width: 3.6
#| fig-height: 3.25
# method pairs on the full multiverse (upper) and averaged over all ablated
# multiverses (lower), i.e. the rows of the heatmap above
p <- vis_inter_method_matrix(
  ablation_fert$inter_method_stability_summary,
  include_negative = FALSE,
  value_size = 1.6
) + theme_stability_compact(wrap_y_labels = FALSE)
p
ggsave(here("figures", "fertility-ablation-inter-method-matrix.pdf"), p, width = 3.6, height = 3.25, create.dir = TRUE)
```

## Intra-method stability

For each method separately, compare its full-multiverse importance vector to
the importance vector obtained after fixing one decision to one option, then
average those correlations over the options of the fixed decision.

```{r fertility-ablation-intra-method-table}
ablation_fert$intra_method_stability_summary |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation,
    mean_abs_difference
  )
```

```{r fertility-ablation-intra-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 2.35
#| fig-height: 2.15
p_intra_fert <- vis_intra_method_stability(
  ablation_fert$intra_method_stability_summary,
  include_negative = FALSE,
  decision_order = decision_order_fert,
  value_size = 1.6
) + theme_stability_compact()
p_intra_fert
```

```{r fertility-ablation-save-heatmaps}
# the intra-method heatmap is sized to match the tiles, text and legend of
# the inter-method matrix, so the two can be placed side by side
ggsave(here("figures", "fertility-ablation-inter-method.pdf"), p_inter_fert, width = 3.2, height = 3, create.dir = TRUE)
ggsave(here("figures", "fertility-ablation-intra-method.pdf"), p_intra_fert, width = 2.35, height = 2.15, create.dir = TRUE)
```
